title: Fix comment provenance hint and document comment edit/delete
description:
Problem: comment ergonomics and provenance, as reported 2026-10-12/13: comments could not be edited or deleted; provenance was sometimes wrong (a comment labelled with the wrong agent, "Cursor / Composer 2.5"); kbs comment printed a provenance tagging hint instead of a plain confirmation; a stray duplicate comment could not be removed.

Verification note: installed kbs 0.32.0 already has kbs comment update and kbs comment delete (by comment id prefix) and kbs comment ensure-ids, so the edit/delete part may be fixed in 0.32.0 or unknown to the reporting sessions; the reporter may have used an older binary. Please confirm and close that part. Could not verify the wrong-agent label or the hint output without writing a comment.

Acceptance:
- Edit and delete are documented in CLI_REFERENCE.md and discoverable from kbs comment --help (flags or subcommands, whichever is chosen).
- Provenance comes from the actual caller (environment or an explicit --agent-* flag); never guessed. Missing provenance is a warning only on stderr.
- kbs comment prints a clear one-line confirmation including the issue id and comment id; hints go to stderr.
- Gherkin scenario covering add, edit, delete.

Reproduced 2026-10-13 with kbs 0.32.0: kbs create without agent flags printed "To add it in one step: kbs update <id> --agent-platform "Cursor" --agent-model "Composer 2.5" --agent-name "Cloud Agent"" even though the caller was Claude Code. The suggested hint hardcodes a wrong platform and model, which is the likely source of the mislabelled comment.
right_now_summary: The team is verifying provenance fixes and documenting comment editing, deletion, and confirmation output.
